scientific_corrections.issue: Brier skill forecast/reference normalization and climatology mismatch
scientific_corrections.counterexample: labels=[0,0,0,1], all forecasts=[.75,.25], num_classes=2: old skill=.625 although forecast equals climatology; corrected skill=0. Perfect forecast gives1.

scientific_corrections.issue: Class reliability conditions on true class and top-label event
scientific_corrections.counterexample: labels=[0,1,0,1], all forecasts=[.75,.25]: old class0 curve=(.75,1); correct one-vs-rest reliability point=(.75,.5).
truth=[-2,-4], prediction=[-1,-2]: old denominator1e-8 produced1.5e10 percent; correct MAPE=50 percent.

scientific_corrections.issue: Rank-calibration bin centers and conditional standard deviations
scientific_corrections.counterexample: Identical four-point uncertainty/error rankings with bins=2 require centers [.25,.75] and zero conditional std; old centers [.025,.525] and variance using a vector of other-bin means were wrong.

scientific_corrections.issue: Dropped upper occupied prediction/spread bins, including all constant spreads
scientific_corrections.counterexample: 20 observations with sigma=1 all assigned outside the loop in old compute_skill_score; corrected count sum20 and RMSE1 for residual1.

scientific_corrections.issue: Unpaired missing-value filtering and sparse percentile windows
scientific_corrections.counterexample: ale=[1,NaN,3,4], epi=[2,2,NaN,5] must retain pairs (1,2),(4,5); independent filtering fabricated pair(3,2). 5-95% clipping of two points may exclude every pair.
sigma=0 has CRPS |y-mu| and right-continuous pointmass CDF 1[y>=mu]; scipy normal sigma0 otherwise gives NaN. Discrete PIT does not inherit continuous uniformity.
